error.message: Unsupported index format: Format version is not supported (resource BufferedChecksumIndexInput(MemorySegmentIndexInput(path="/data/indexes/products/segments_2"))): Index has segments derived from Lucene version 8.x and is not supported by Lucene 10.5.2. This Lucene version only supports indexes with major version 9 or later (found: 8, minimum supported: 9). To resolve this issue re-index your data using Lucene 9.x or later..
